title: Cell sorting of marine heterotrophic flagellates for single-cell genome amplification
author: Camille Poirier
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ywpfxdn
materials: Also stain with 2 µg/ml Hoechst 33342 (to target dsDNA) for 30 mins at room temperature. Hoechst 33342 Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher Catalog #H1399
UV-treat all materials (except cell samples) in a HL-2000 HybriLinker (UVP) for 30-90 mins prior to conducting multiple displacement amplification (MDA).

Lyse samples (both sorted cells and negative controls) for 10 mins at 65°C using buffer D2 from the REPLI-g Single Cell Kit (Qiagen), according to the manufacturer's instructions for amplification of genomic DNA from single cells. REPLI-g Single Cell Kit Qiagen Catalog #150345

Lyse samples (both sorted cells and negative controls) for 10 mins at 65°C using buffer D2 from the REPLI-g Single Cell Kit (Qiagen), according to the manufacturer's instructions for amplification of genomic DNA from single cells. REPLI-g Single Cell Kit Qiagen Catalog #150345

steps.title: Pre‑filter and concentrate water sample
steps.instruction: Pre‑filter the water sample through a 30 µm mesh, then concentrate it by gravity filtration ~100‑fold onto a 0.8 µm filter to obtain approximately 1–2 ml of concentrate.

steps.title: Pellet and wash cells with ASW
steps.instruction: Pellet the concentrated cells by centrifugation for 3 min at 6,000 × g, wash with 2 ml sterile artificial sea water (ASW) to remove unbound dye, repeat the centrifugation, and finally resuspend the pellet in 2 ml ASW.

steps.title: Resuspend cells and stain with Paclitaxel
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend the cells from the filter using 1–2 ml sterile ASW and stain 500 µl of the cell concentrate with 10 µM Paclitaxel‑Oregon Green (use a 1:100 dilution of a 1 mM stock prepared in DMSO and stored at –20 °C; Life Technologies catalog #P22310).

steps.title: Incubate stained cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the stained cell suspension for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Set up flow cytometer
steps.instruction: Configure a flow cytometer equipped with 488 nm and 355 nm lasers and load sterile nuclease‑free 1× PBS (pH 7.4; Invitrogen catalog #AM9625) as sheath fluid.

steps.title: UV‑illuminate sorting plates
steps.instruction: Place the 96‑well sorting plates inside the sort chamber and expose them to UV radiation for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Configure sort gates and controls
steps.instruction: Set sort windows to select cells positive for both green (520/35 nm bandpass for Oregon Green) and blue (460/50 nm bandpass for Hoechst 33342) fluorescence while showing baseline red (692/40 nm) to exclude chlorophyll; regularly check sort quality with fluorescent beads (do not add beads to actual samples).

steps.title: Sort single cells into plates
steps.instruction: Using single‑cell sorting mode, deposit one cell per well into the 96‑well plate; leave the outer column empty for sheath‑fluid only negative controls.

steps.title: Seal plates and freeze
steps.instruction: Cover the sorted plates with foil and place them immediately at –80 °C.

steps.title: Perform MDA amplification
steps.instruction: After neutralization, amplify each well with the REPLI‑g kit to a final volume of 50 µl; incubate for 8 h at 30 °C with the thermocycler lid set to 65–70 °C.

steps.title: Aliquot amplified DNA
steps.instruction: From each MDA reaction aliquot: a) 2 µl, dilute 100‑fold for PCR and store at –20 °C; b) 20 µl as a backup stored at –80 °C; c) 28 µl stored at –80 °C; retain 25 µl for later sequencing.

steps.title: Dilute MDA product for PCR
steps.instruction: Dilute 2 µl of each MDA product 100‑fold in nuclease‑free water and use 2–5 µl of this dilution as template in a 25 µl PCR reaction.

steps.title: PCR amplify 18S V9 region
steps.instruction: Set up 25 µl PCRs with Phusion High‑Fidelity DNA Polymerase (100 U, NEB catalog #M0530S), 0.35 µM each primer (1389F: 5’‑TTGTACACACCGCCC‑3’, 1510R: 5’‑CCTTCYGCAGGTTCACCTAC‑3’), 3 % DMSO, 2× GC buffer; thermocycle: 98 °C 30 s; 25 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 57 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; final extension 72 °C 10 min.

steps.title: Run gel and excise bands
steps.instruction: Separate PCR products on a 1 % agarose gel stained with GelGreen, visualize bands with a blue‑light transilluminator, and excise the desired bands.

steps.title: Purify amplicons and quantify
steps.instruction: Purify excised bands using the GeneJet gel extraction kit (Thermo Scientific), quantify DNA with a Qubit fluorometer using the dsDNA BR kit (Invitrogen), and submit purified amplicons for Sanger sequencing (Eurofins Genomics).

steps.title: Purify selected MDA samples
steps.instruction: Take 25 µl of each chosen MDA sample (including six negative controls: four outer‑well sorts and two kit buffer controls) and clean with AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter catalog #A63880) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Quantify and normalize DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with Qubit, then dilute each sample in 10 mM Tris‑Cl (pH 8.0) to a final amount of 1 µg in 130 µl total volume; for negative controls add the ~20 µl sample plus Tris‑Cl up to 130 µl (≈110 µl Tris‑Cl).

steps.title: Fragment DNA with Covaris
steps.instruction: Fragment the normalized DNA using a Covaris E220 focused‑acoustic system, then concentrate the fragmented sample.

steps.title: Prepare libraries – Blue Pippin method
steps.instruction: Using the Nextflex Rapid DNA library kit and BIOO indexes (no PCR), pool 3 µl of each sample, concentrate, and size‑select fragments 450–650 bp with a Blue Pippin 1.5 % agarose cassette (R2 marker); the recovered libraries average ~420 bp (≈295 bp inserts).

steps.title: Prepare libraries – Bead selection method
steps.instruction: Perform bead‑based size selection of the library pool to retain fragments 420–620 bp, quantify the libraries by qPCR, and pool them equimolarly at 2 nM.

steps.title: Denature and sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Denature the pooled libraries, dilute as required, and run 250 bp paired‑end sequencing across two lanes on an Illumina HiSeq 2500 using Rapid Run SBS v2 reagents.
